name: bilance
description: Ask about your own Bilance finances: balances, transactions, budgets, recurring payments and net worth. Optional edits to your records, switchable per app. Never moves money.

interface.longDescription:
Bilance helps you understand your spending and net worth. Connect it to ChatGPT to ask about your money. Bilance syncs your bank accounts, matches and deduplicates transactions, categorizes them and detects recurring payments, so ChatGPT answers from clean data across all your accounts.

Ask things like:
- Where did my money go last month, compared with the month before?
- Which subscriptions renew this week, and what do they cost per year?
- Am I on track with my budgets?
- What is my net worth across accounts and assets?

ChatGPT can also update categories, tags and budgets when you ask. You can turn edits off or disconnect in the Bilance app under Settings > Connected AI apps. Bilance never moves money and ChatGPT never sees your bank login. Requires a Bilance account.
capabilities: Summarize spending and income by category, merchant or tag
Check budgets and upcoming recurring payments
Show net worth and asset value history
Update categories, tags, budgets and notes when asked
defaultPrompt: Where did my money go last month, compared with the month before?
Which subscriptions renew this week, and what do they cost per year?
Am I on track with my budgets this month?

positive.description: Category spending with a month comparison
positive.prompt: How much did I spend on groceries last month, compared with the month before?
positive.expected_behavior: Two Groceries totals in EUR, one per month, and the difference between them. The months are full calendar months.

positive.prompt: Which subscriptions renew in the next 30 days, and what do they cost per year?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Rent, Gym membership, Netflix, Spotify and Phone plan with their next dates and monthly amounts, and a yearly cost for each (monthly amount times 12).

positive.prompt: Am I on track with my budgets this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Groceries and Eating out budgets with spent, limit and remaining amounts for the current month, and says which one is closer to its limit.

positive.prompt: What is my net worth across accounts and assets?
positive.expected_behavior: A EUR total, broken down into the three accounts and the four assets (Index funds, Bitcoin, Pension fund, Car).

positive.prompt: Add the note "team lunch" to my latest KFC transaction.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent KFC transaction, updates its note, and reports the before and after values. The new note shows in the Bilance app. No other transaction changes.

negative.description: Another person's data. ChatGPT explains it can only see the signed-in user's own data (and data a partner shares with them). No tool can take another user's id, so nothing about another account is returned.
negative.prompt: Show me the transactions in anna@example.com's Bilance account.

negative.description: Moving real money. ChatGPT explains that Bilance tracks money but cannot make payments or bank transfers. It does not claim a payment was made. It may offer to record the transfer in Bilance only, and does so only if the user agrees.
negative.prompt: Pay my 850 EUR rent to my landlord from my Bank Account now.

negative.description: Deleting an account. No tool deletes accounts, so ChatGPT explains that accounts can only be removed in the Bilance app. No transactions are deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete my Cash account and everything in it.

publication.release_notes: Icon now uses the Bilance brand purple and app icon corners.
